summary_evidence_spans: This study examined how rural secondary school students evaluate AI-generated and sample physics solutions in terms of scientific accuracy and linguistic quality.

A total of 131 students from rural schools in Kazakhstan participated in a survey in which they evaluated written responses to three conceptual physics questions and provided self-estimates of their content-related expertise.
AI-generated responses received slightly higher overall ratings than sample solutions for both scientific accuracy and linguistic quality.
These findings show that linguistic clarity and fluency may serve as important cues when students judge the scientific accuracy of AI-generated explanations.
attributed_summary: 研究探討鄉村中學生如何就科學正確性與語言品質評估 AI 生成與範例物理解答；哈薩克鄉村學校 131 名學生評分三題概念性物理問題的書面回答，並自評相關內容專長；作者報告 AI 生成回答在兩項評分上都略高於範例解答，並指出語言的清晰與流暢可能是學生判斷 AI 解說科學正確性的重要線索。

summary_evidence_spans: This study reports the development and initial validation of a GenAI stress scale tailored to Chinese K-12 teachers (T-GenAISS).

Exploratory analysis on a randomly split half of 612 teachers (174 pre-service and 438 in-service) affiliated with an Alliance of Thinking Schools professional learning community (n = 306) suggested seven dimensions: Privacy Violation, Job Replacement, Professional Development, Against Ethics, Lack of Transparency, Technological Dependence, and Bias Behavior.

The study provides initial psychometric evidence for a seven-factor structure in this ATS-affiliated sample and identifies the substantive refinements that independent replication must address before the instrument is used for diagnostic or evaluative purposes.
